name: Integration for Mailchimp – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor, Gravity Forms & More
author: Plugcrux

sections.description:
The Integration for Mailchimp plugin seamlessly integrates Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, and Formidable Forms with Mailchimp.

It automatically adds subscribers or records and syncs form submissions to your Mailchimp audience in real time, helping you grow and manage your email list efficiently.

Helpful Resources
🚀 Video Tutorial | 🚀 Contact Support | 🚀 Request Feature | 🚀 Official Website | 🚀 Upgrade to Pro

Supported Form Builders:
– Contact Form 7
– WPForms
– Elementor Forms
– Gravity Forms
– Formidable Forms

Authentication

  • Navigate to the Accounts page in the plugin.
  • Click the Add Account button — a popup will appear.
  • Enter a meaningful Account Name (e.g., “Main Mailchimp Account”).
  • Enter your Mailchimp API Key manually into the API Key field.
  • Click Save Account to store the credentials.
  • Once saved, your Mailchimp account will appear in the list.

Add Integration

  • Go to the Setup page to configure new integrations.
  • Click the Add Integration button to open the setup popup.
  • Enter an Integration Name (e.g., “Newsletter Signup Form”).
  • Select the Form you want to connect (e.g., Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor).
  • Choose the Mailchimp Account you connected earlier.
  • Select the Audience (List) in Mailchimp where subscribers should be added.
  • Map form fields to Mailchimp fields in the Field Mapping section (e.g., map “your-email” → “EMAIL,” “your-name” → “FNAME”).
  • Optionally map additional fields like phone, address, or tags.
  • Use the Filter Criteria section to apply conditional logic (e.g., sync only if a certain checkbox is selected).
  • Click Save Mapping to save the integration.

Logs

  • Go to the Logs page to view all activity — you’ll see a list of submissions, their statuses, and messages. Status types include: SUCCESS → Subscriber added successfully, RECORD_FAILED → Sync failed (e.g., invalid email).
  • You can Resync, Delete, or perform Bulk Actions on records.
  • Use filters like Integration, Status, and Time Range to narrow results.
  • Click the Log Details icon to view full error details, form data, and Mailchimp API responses.

Settings

  • Go to the Settings page to manage global plugin settings.
  • Enable Delete Data on Uninstall to remove all plugin data when uninstalled.
  • Enable Error Email Notification to receive alerts for failed sync attempts.
  • Enter Email Addresses (comma-separated) for notifications.
  • Set a Subject Line for notification emails (e.g., “Mailchimp Sync Error”).
  • Click Save Settings to apply.

Upgrade to Pro

Unlock the full power of the Mailchimp Integration plugin with the Premium Version!

The free version helps you get started, but the premium upgrade provides advanced tools, unlimited connections, and enhanced automation — perfect for growing businesses and agencies.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
2. Search for Integrazo and locate this plugin.
3. Click Install and then Activate.
4. Open the plugin settings to connect your Mailchimp account.

Manual Installation
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
2. Activate the plugin.
3. Go to plugin settings and complete your Mailchimp setup.
sections.faq:
Which WordPress forms are supported for Mailchimp integration?

This plugin offers seamless Mailchimp integration with popular WordPress form plugins, allowing you to automatically add subscribers to your Mailchimp lists. Supported form builders include:

  • Contact Form 7 – Automatically subscribe users to Mailchimp lists when they submit a form.
  • WPForms – Sync WPForms entries to Mailchimp in real-time.
  • Elementor Forms – Instantly send Elementor form data to your Mailchimp audience.
  • Gravity Forms – Enable automated Mailchimp list subscriptions from Gravity Forms.
  • Formidable Forms – Add Formidable Forms submissions to Mailchimp with field mapping support.

How to connect Contact Form 7 to Mailchimp?

To integrate Contact Form 7 with Mailchimp:

  • Go to the plugin settings and open the Setup tab.
  • Choose Contact Form 7 from the list of supported forms.
  • Select your connected Mailchimp account and the desired list.
  • Map form fields (e.g., name, email) to Mailchimp fields.
  • Click Save Integration to enable syncing on form submission.

How to integrate WPForms with Mailchimp?

To sync WPForms with Mailchimp:

  • Navigate to the plugin settings and open the Setup tab.
  • Select WPForms as the form plugin.
  • Choose your Mailchimp account and target audience.
  • Map the form fields to Mailchimp merge fields.
  • Save the integration to begin syncing data automatically.

Can I send Elementor Forms submissions to Mailchimp?

Yes, Elementor Forms are fully supported. To set up integration:

  • Go to the Setup section in plugin settings.
  • Choose Elementor Forms.
  • Select the Mailchimp account and target list.
  • Map form fields to Mailchimp fields.
  • Save the settings to start adding subscribers from Elementor Forms.

Does this plugin support Gravity Forms Mailchimp integration?

Absolutely. To connect Gravity Forms:

  • Open plugin settings and go to the Setup tab.
  • Choose Gravity Forms from the supported forms list.
  • Select the connected Mailchimp account and audience.
  • Map your form fields to the Mailchimp list fields.
  • Save and activate the integration to start syncing.

How to connect Formidable Forms with Mailchimp?

Follow these steps to sync Formidable Forms:

  • Go to plugin settings and access the Setup tab.
  • Choose Formidable Forms.
  • Select the Mailchimp account and audience you want to sync with.
  • Map the form fields to Mailchimp merge fields.
  • Save the setup to begin sending submissions to Mailchimp.

Can I map custom fields in Mailchimp?

Yes, you can:

  • Map any form field to a corresponding Mailchimp merge tag (custom field).
  • Use custom fields to segment your subscribers effectively and personalize emails.

What happens if a submission fails to sync with Mailchimp?

If a submission doesn’t sync:

  • It will be logged in the Error Logs tab.
  • You can review detailed error messages for each failed submission.
  • Retry failed records individually or in bulk.
  • Reach out to Support for help.

Is a Mailchimp account required?

Yes, you must have an active Mailchimp account to use this plugin and sync form data.

How secure is the integration with Mailchimp?

The plugin is designed with top-level security:

  • All data is transmitted using secure, encrypted communication.
  • Follows GDPR-compliant practices to ensure data privacy and user consent.
